summary: Paired same-corpus / post-cutoff out-of-corpus external-test design with DOI-level + bounded cell-level (scContam Signal A) pre-training contamination audit for the Geneformer V2-104M (Genecorpus-104M) fine-tuning study.

pretraining_corpus.name: Genecorpus-104M
pretraining_corpus.source_table: NatCS 2026 SI MOESM3 sheet 'genecorpus_104m' (2,903 rows, 563 unique DOIs)

GSE153515.title: Limbal basal epithelium, Li et al. The Ocular Surface 2021
GSE153515.verdict: LIKELY IN pre-training corpus (DOI-level, decisive); no time exemption
GSE153515.note: Disjoint from the fine-tuning atlas at donor/study level (donor_disjoint=true, source_disjoint=true vs training atlas); NOT claimed disjoint from the pre-training corpus

GSE299152.title: Human ocular-surface single-cell map (glycocalyx), PNAS Nexus 2025
GSE299152.verdict: OUT of pre-training corpus (post-cutoff publication; DOI absent from the corpus source table)
GSE299152.note: 3 donors (Donor2046/2206/3748) disjoint from the 49 training donors

audit_methods.pipeline: GEO record -> PubMed ID (NCBI eutils esummary) -> Crossref DOI -> lookup in NatCS SI MOESM3 'genecorpus_104m' table
audit_methods.result: GSE153515 primary DOI resolved to a corpus row (53,290 cells, organ=eye); GSE299152 DOI absent

audit_methods.method: Geneformer V2 rank-encoding fingerprints (top-2048 tokens; official token_dictionary_gc104M.pkl + gene_median_dictionary_gc104M.pkl); vectorised MinHash m=128 b=16 r=8 + banded LSH + exact Jaccard
audit_methods.corpus_scope: 7 uniformly sampled shards, ~0.6M cells (full 1,202-shard / ~600 GB corpus not downloaded)

secondary_finding.note: Disclosed for completeness; does not affect external-test conclusions (donor/study-disjoint from the training atlas)

framing_claim: donor/study-disjoint from the fine-tuning atlas (holds for both tests); disjoint from the pre-training corpus (claimed ONLY for GSE299152, NOT for GSE153515)
